info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Insurance Claims Claims Documents-v2-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Document Retrieval API allows users to access and retrieve documents associated with insurance claims. This API is designed for insurance providers and adjusters seeking to facilitate the claims process by obtaining necessary documentation. By utilizing this endpoint, users can effectively manage and track claim-related documents to ensure a smooth workflow. Typical consumers include claims analysts and customer service teams who require quick access to relevant claim documentation.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve documents related to claims, facilitating access to necessary information for claim processing and review.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving claims documents. This body is structured in JSON format and contains the necessary data to specify the claims documents being requested.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested documents.
